material.description: From the user: when a hero is selected, load its model; while selecting, load every model picked by other players as soon as it is picked; announce each load so the UI can show it. Current state: js/client/play.js preloadReadyHeroes (around 323 and 1571) preloads only seats with s.ready; scenarios/moba/panels.lua lobby_seats_event already sends model for any picked seat. Change: preload any seat with a model (not only ready); when parsedModel resolves, dispatch window event oscraft:model-loaded with detail {model: <model name>}, once per model; a failed load is retried once and logged. Ownership: js/client/play.js only. Acceptance: CI green on ci and pages; the event fires once per picked model during selection (confirm by console log in the browser lane).

notes.note: Evidence from lobby-model-preview-widget (session drain-modelview-13): pages job 'first draw of the built page' fails at origin/main 6d8e7388 (run 40189057060, median-ms=11772 loads=3 ceiling-ms=10000, transferred-bytes=22836245 requests=282) and again at f356dd23 (run 40189392669, same ceiling breach). The only file that differs from the last green pages sha 53eecaea (pages 4/4 success) is js/client/play.js, so 6d8e7388 is the cause. The ceiling is not to be raised. Owner: preload lane (play.js). Please fix play.js so the first-draw wire stays under ceiling; the model preload must not run before first draw.

The console-log check (event once per picked model during selection in a browser) is a browser look, left to the browser lane.
